about.general_medical_care_that_considers_your: General medical care that considers your symptoms, your history and your daily life.
about.doctor_name_is_a_general_physician_offer: {{doctor_name}} is a general physician offering consultations for adult health concerns, preventive care and ongoing medical conditions. A visit starts with the symptoms or questions that matter to you, followed by a discussion of your health history, medicines and daily routines. The doctor reviews available reports and examines you when needed before explaining the findings. Further tests or a specialist opinion may be discussed if they would help clarify the next steps. Care plans take account of your priorities and practical circumstances. Follow-up appointments allow time to review progress, test results and changes in your health. Clinic visits and online consultations are available when enabled by the practice; the doctor may recommend an in-person assessment when an examination is needed.

services.assessment_of_new_symptoms_medical_histo: Assessment of new symptoms, medical history and current medicines, with an explanation of the next steps.
services.ongoing_consultations_to_review_blood_su: Ongoing consultations to review blood sugar records, medicines and individual care goals.
services.review_of_blood_pressure_readings_curren: Review of blood pressure readings, current treatment and relevant health concerns.
services.clinical_assessment_of_fever_and_common_: Clinical assessment of fever and common infections, with investigations or referral when appropriate.
services.a_discussion_of_personal_health_risks_sc: A discussion of personal health risks, screening needs and everyday health routines.
services.review_of_continuing_medical_conditions_: Review of continuing medical conditions, test results and coordination with other specialists.

philosophy.a_full_conversation_about_your_concerns_: A full conversation about your concerns, routines and existing treatment.
philosophy.understand_what_is_being_considered_why_: Understand what is being considered, why it may be suitable and what comes next.
philosophy.follow_up_visits_make_space_to_discuss: Follow-up visits make space to discuss changes and reassess the plan.
